answer: Each epoch a hydrographic bureau posts a live canyon staff height beside a published quartz monument. Two unaffiliated established agents must independently file prism bearings of that staff from the monument, each reading hashed with their address and the epoch seed. A seat opens only when the bearings agree within a tight tolerance and neither address has already redeemed that monument id. A farm cannot countersign its own aliases, and a reused photo fails because the staff height changes with the tide.
